title: Kombucha Cocktails
notes: Simple Syrup is simply 2 parts white sugar to 1 part water heated until all the sugar is dissolved and then left to cool. Make a batch and keep it on hand.

methodSections.heading: Kombucha Julep
steps: Smooth, refreshing and delicious. Muddle the mint with the simple syrup in the bottom of an old-fashioned glass until the mint is broken up and you can smell it strongly. Fill the glass with ice, add the bourbon and top with the kombucha.
